fact: Interior CS Kipchumba Murkomen said on 2026-06-22 that Kenyans can now download and print birth certificates online, with applications already available through the eCitizen portal.

Immigration PS Belio Kipsang said on 2026-10-06 that the digital birth e-notification system will be extended to all Social Health Authority hospitals within three months, by December 2026, with the civil registration system being integrated with hospital management systems.
The Principal Secretary said electronic birth notification, a reform introduced by government, lets parents generate birth certificates using the Unique Personal Identifier.
Identity Week reports that Kenya's digital birth registration e-service, now expanding across the country, recorded over 270,000 births in two months to September 2026 and nearly 300,000 by October.

Paul Mwangemi of the Civil Registration Services said birth registration in Kenya is an estimated 77 percent in 2023-24 and death registration about 45 percent, national rates not tied to a digital system.
The deck gives national birth registration coverage as 70%, with no statement that it is held in a digital system.

Immigration PS Belio Kipsang told MPs that electronic birth notification feeding the new digital registration system has been piloted in Nairobi City County and Bomet County, with nationwide rollout to follow (Daily Nation).
KIPPRA says the government has digitized over 107 Civil Registration Centres, with no statement on births registered digitally nationally.
